definitions: To reduce (something) to small particles or powder by crushing it.
To sharpen, smooth, or polish (something) with a grinding action.
To rub or press (something) with a harsh, grating sound.
To operate (a mill or other machine) by turning a handle.
examples: She needs to grind the coffee beans.
He will grind the axe to make it sharp.
The gears started to grind loudly.
They used to grind grain at the mill.
You have to grind through the last few chapters.
